title: Rollback Schema
description: Structure for rollback events when a previously approved clinical output must be withdrawn (retracted source, superseded guideline, safety signal, error found).

rollback_record_structure.target_approval_id: string — approval_id of the record being invalidated
rollback_record_structure.rollback_reason: string — enum: SOURCE_RETRACTED / GUIDELINE_SUPERSEDED / SAFETY_SIGNAL / ERROR_FOUND / PATIENT_SAFETY_CONCERN / OTHER
rollback_record_structure.initiated_by: string — 'doctor' always — AI may FLAG for rollback but cannot initiate
rollback_record_structure.affected_cards: array of string — EBM_MASTER card IDs affected
rollback_record_structure.affected_dashboards: array of string — dashboard file names affected
rollback_record_structure.replacement_output_id: string or null — ID of the replacement output if available
rollback_record_structure.notification_sent_to: array of string — roles notified (not names/emails due to PII rules)
rollback_record_structure.retraction_watch_entry: string or null — RETRACTION_AND_CORRECTION_WATCH.jsonl entry ID

rollback_cascade_rules: Rolling back an output MUST set its release_state to 'retired_or_superseded' in OUTPUT_SCHEMA.
Rolling back for SOURCE_RETRACTED MUST also quarantine all EBM_MASTER cards citing that source.
Rolling back for GUIDELINE_SUPERSEDED MUST flag all dashboards using the old guideline for review.
Rollback events MUST be logged to AUDIT_LOG.jsonl within 1 hour of initiation.
Doctor who approved the original output MUST be notified (via NOTIFICATION record — no PII).
invariants: Only a doctor (initiated_by='doctor') may execute a rollback.
AI may create a rollback PROPOSAL (status=DRAFT) but it takes no effect until doctor approves.
Rollback records are immutable — no deletion; only append a correction record if wrong.
ALL rollback events trigger addition to RETRACTION_AND_CORRECTION_WATCH.jsonl.
